links.comparator_used: unconstrained prompt without an explicit admission-time constraint
links.outcome: Leakage of a prediction-time-invalid feature across 10 runs per condition
links.effect: Leaked in 10/10 unconstrained runs vs 0/10 with the explicit admission-time constraint, for both DeepSeek Flash and GPT-6-astra
links.tradeoff: The contrast is version-sensitive: a blinded Claude/Fable-5.1 chat run did not leak in either condition, and explicit-constraint violations appear in a historical August 2026 slice lacking raw trajectories.
links.quote: In fully logged September 2026 A/B runs, DeepSeek Flash and GPT-6-astra each leak in 10/10 unconstrained runs and 0/10 runs with an explicit admission-time constraint.
